device.name: Isaac Lab ANYmal D blind flat (Isaac-Quadruped-AnymalD-Blind-Flat-v0)

facts.text: The repository is an Isaac Lab extension with tasks for training quadruped robots using reinforcement learning
Five task types train three quadruped robots, ANYmal D, Go2 and Spot
The installation begins by installing NVIDIA Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab separately
The extension is installed with pip install -e exts/omni.isaac.lab_quadruped_tasks
The task registrations import gymnasium as gym
Isaac-Quadruped-AnymalD-Blind-Flat-v0 is registered with entry_point omni.isaac.lab.envs:ManagerBasedRLEnv and env_cfg_entry_point AnymalDBlindFlatEnvCfg
AnymalDBlindFlatEnvCfg is defined in the clone and extends AnymalDBaseEnvCfg
The blind flat task disables the height scanner, the height-map observation, the velocity-command event and the terrain-level curriculum
The action term is JointPositionActionCfg with asset_name 'robot', joint_names ['.*'], scale 0.5 and use_default_offset True

The policy observation terms are the velocity command, base linear velocity, base angular velocity, projected gravity, joint positions, joint velocities, last action and, when enabled, a clipped height map; the base and joint measurements carry Gaussian noise
The policy observation group concatenates its terms and enables corruption by default
The environment applies decimation 4 with sim.dt 1/200 s, episode_length_s 20.0 and seed 42
INSTALL_REQUIRES lists numpy, torch 2.4.0, torchvision, protobuf, h5py, tensorboard and moviepy
The extension package requires Python 3.10 or newer

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the fake's initial joint positions and every later transition is a deterministic kinematic update, so one seed and one action sequence repeat the state hashes; the registered Isaac Lab environment, which was not run, seeds its own simulation and randomization (quadruped_env_cfg.py:306)

gaps: F0: the fake backend is an analytic kinematic stand-in, not Isaac Lab; it moves its joint positions directly toward the action and models no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors or noise

the fake's action and observation dimensions are placeholders (RESULT.json notes); the configured task writes one joint-position target per joint matched by joint_names ['.*'] of the external robot asset and concatenates the observation terms, whose real dimensions depend on that asset and are not in the clone
the fake never terminates or truncates; the configured episode_length_s is 20 s (quadruped_env_cfg.py:300-301) but no episode limit is modelled

no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0; one environment step applies decimation 4 physics steps and timestep_ms names the physics timestep 1/200 s, so one tick is 20 ms of simulated time (quadruped_env_cfg.py:300-305)
the fake was never compared with the registered Isaac Lab environment: Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab are external and were not installed, and the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
